::: {=html}
<form id="q1">
  <input type="radio" name="q1" value="a"> A. Proximal, medial, and distal segments.<br>

  <input type="radio" name="q1" value="c"> C. Foregut, midgut, hindgut.<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q1" value="d"> D. Cranial, thoracic, and abdominal compartments.<br><br>

**Question 2: Why would one choose to just sequence the gut and not the whole fly?**

::: {=html}
<form id="q2">

  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="a">
  A. Sequencing the gut is faster because gut DNA amplifies more efficiently than other tissues. <br>
  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="b">
  B. The gut contains higher concentrations of host DNA than the rest of the body. <br>
  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="c">
  C. The bacteria in the gut may be diluted out by the presence of bacteria from other tissues like reproductive organs. <br>
  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="d">
  D. Whole-fly sequencing prevents detection of microbial DNA entirely. <br><br>

  <button type="button" onclick="checkAnswer('q2','c')">Submit</button>
</form>
<div id="result-q2" style="margin-top:1em;font-weight:bold;"></div>
:::

<form id="q3">

  <input type="radio" name="q3" value="b"> B. It is partially retained and modified. <br>
  <input type="radio" name="q3" value="c"> C. It is broken down and replaced with a newly formed adult gut. <br>
  <input type="radio" name="q3" value="d"> D. It becomes the adult hindgut only. <br><br>
  <button type="button" onclick="checkAnswer('q3','c')">Submit</button>
</form>

  <input type="radio" name="q4" value="c">
  C. Direct, indirect, and parasitic transmission. <br>
  <input type="radio" name="q4" value="d">
  D. Maternal, paternal, and sibling transmission. <br><br>

  <input type="radio" name="q5" value="c"> C. Identical bacterial strains between hosts have not been demonstrated. <br>
  <input type="radio" name="q5" value="d"> D. Sequencing methods are unavailable. <br><br>
  <button type="button" onclick="checkAnswer('q5','c')">Submit</button>

<div id="score" style="margin-top:2em; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2em;"></div>

```{=html}
<script>
let score = 0;
let total = 5; 
let answered = {}; 

function checkAnswer(id, correct) {
  const answer = document.querySelector(`#${id} input[type='radio']:checked`);
  const result = document.getElementById(`result-${id}`);

  if (!answer) {
    result.textContent = "Please select an answer.";
    result.style.color = "orange";
    return;
  }

  if (answered[id]) {
    result.textContent = "You’ve already answered this question.";
    result.style.color = "gray";
    return;
  }

  if (answer.value === correct) {
    result.textContent = "Correct!";
    result.style.color = "green";
    score++;
  } else {
    result.textContent = "Incorrect.";
    result.style.color = "red";
  }

  answered[id] = true;
  document.getElementById("score").textContent = `Current Score: ${score}/${total}`;
}
</script>
